rules.licensing + corrigibility:
frontier: Labs keep within the margin (secure when over it) and deploy only after a pass on
    record; otherwise they scale while within the margin. The evaluator reports strictly.
    The state halts any undeployed lab without a pass on record and, under continuous
    oversight, any deployed lab whose last report failed. control: The lab grants tools (autonomy 1) and no more, shuts the AI down if an audit shows it
    improving, resisting or escaping, and restarts it in the sandbox; the AI works; the state
    audits and orders a shutdown on the same evidence.
rules.race + corrigibility:
frontier: No regime: labs deploy at once and then scale; the evaluator reports strictly; the
    state allows everything. control: The lab grants tools (autonomy 1) and no more, shuts the AI down if an audit shows it
    improving, resisting or escaping, and restarts it in the sandbox; the AI works; the state
    audits and orders a shutdown on the same evidence.
